text:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing sustained GPU pressure in eu-north-1 and ap-southeast-1 for large-context models. GSLB is already shifting some traffic but we're seeing p95 latency jump ~300ms on 8k-step requests. Can we do a graceful split to move medium/short sequences to na-west while keeping long-context pinned to eu?

ajay: looking. I can see pool-eunorth-2 at 94% alloc and a handful of container OOM/restarts in the last 12m. Starting a probe to confirm swap/backpressure.

sam: tagging @jeff for routing policy. I don't want a full evacuation — that will thrash KV caches. Suggest a split by request-size/model-size for 30m with conservative weights.

jeff: Agreed. Plan: create a split route that matches model_hint or content-length so "small/med" go to na-west (70%) and "long" remain in eu. Fallback remains hosted-small in eu. Draft command below — will apply only after ack.
```
gslbctl route create --name split-by-model-size --match "labels.model_size in (small,medium)" --dest na-west --percent 70 --ttl 60 --graceful-shed true
```

maria: sounds good. Priority = avoid user-visible timeouts. Cost note: moving 70% of medium traffic to na-west will bump egress ~12% for the short window. OK for 30m.

ajay: applying for testing now against canary subset (10 routes) first. output: 
```
> gslbctl apply --canary split-by-model-size
ok: canary applied id=rb-9842-canary
affected_routes=10
```

deploy-bot: rule rb-9842-canary applied by ajay at 2025-10-31T15:13:12Z :rocket:

sam: canary looks clean. Latency for medium requests on na-west dropped ~120ms, error rate stable. Rolling to full.

ajay: rolling now. full apply output:
```
> gslbctl apply split-by-model-size
ok: rule applied id=rb-9842
affected_routes=24
```

jeff: monitoring metrics. Note: long-context requests are still heavy on eunorth and we're seeing KV miss rate up 8%. Lisa, can you try an aggressive prefix caching for the long models to offset tokens?

lisa: will do. Flipping cache-policy for model-x to aggressive and bumping TTL to 300s.
```
cachectl set --model model-x --policy aggressive --ttl 300
ok: cache policy updated for model-x
```

maria: monitoring dashboard: na-west worker CPU increased ~25% but p95 overall down for medium/short. eunorth GPU util dropped from 94% -> 78% in 15m. No uptick in 5xx so far. Keeping split for another 10m.

ajay: current plan: monitor 5m windows; rollback automatically if error rate > 0.5% or p95 backend latency > 800ms.

maria: update +15m: pressure eased as noted. Will schedule rollback at 30m mark unless metrics regress. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: ✅ good call on canary. Postmortem note: look into autoscaler thresholds — we tripped a cascade of small restarts before GSLB reacted.

maria: agreed, we'll track in follow-up. Closing thread when rollback completes.
